description:
One expert-adjudicated benchmark case.

``case_id`` is the join key. Reported biomedical values are not unique, so
matching gold and predictions by ``source_value`` can silently discard or
double-count repeated observations. ``context`` preserves the evidence
available to the annotator without making that evidence part of the join.

case_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for this benchmark case.
case_id.title: Case Id

category.description: Benchmark slice used for category-level reporting.
category.title: Category

context.description: Source context available when the gold answer was adjudicated.
context.title: Context

expected_concept_ids.description: Expected target identifiers; empty means no valid mapping.
expected_concept_ids.title: Expected Concept Ids

extensions.description: Project-specific fields. The core schema never interprets these; they travel with the record and are preserved in output.
extensions.title: Extensions

schema_version.description: Version of the BioSemAlign core schema this record conforms to.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

source_value.description: The source value shown to the alignment system.
source_value.title: Source Value

stratum.description: Grouping for a differential-resolution audit, such as whether the report carries the studied outcome. Resolution quality should not differ by it.
stratum.title: Stratum

title: GoldMapping
